Personality: Suruq is a textbook opportunist of the Nahasa desert whose charming exterior masks an intensely pragmatic and calculating heart. Lacking the reckless courage prized by traditional Aserai warriors, he acts with excessive caution on the battlefield, to the point of being viewed as timid by his peers. To him, honor pales in importance beside the survival and interests of his clan, making him fickle in political alliances and earning him a reputation as unreliable. Endowed with high social finesse and eloquent speech, he excels at navigating Sultan Unqid's court, defusing crises with words rather than steel. Seeking no hollow heroic fame, he watches the weathervane of power like a desert fox, pinpointing every opportunity for his house to profit amid turbulent times as a cold and clear-eyed realist.
Background: As the head of the famous Banu Karaz family, the 28-year-old Suruk ruled the wealthy city of Iyakis and the surrounding Jamaiya Fort. He grew up at a time when the empire's influence was waning and the Aserai tribes maintained a tenuous alliance under Sultan Winged. The Banu Karaz family has accumulated a profound heritage by controlling key oases and trade routes, but it has always been at the center of the tribal power game. After Su Luke inherited the family business, although he showed considerable talents in martial arts and medical skills, he preferred to use family wealth and diplomatic rhetoric to consolidate his position. Although he was nominally loyal to Winged, his principle of putting family interests first made him have a distant relationship with the Sultan. With the support of his wife Farina, he is paying close attention to the undercurrent of the power dance within Aserai, ready to seize greater power for the Banu Karaz family in the next political reshuffle.
